```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(grid)
library(here)

# Load existing plotting functions
source(here('scripts', 'src', 'assessment_plot_func.R'))

# Path settings
rds_path = here('data', 'processed')
plot_path = here('output')
if (!dir.exists(plot_path)) dir.create(plot_path, recursive = TRUE)

# Load data
poly_df = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'poly_cleaned.rds'))

# Constants
cm = 1 / 2.54
age_breaks = seq(0, 80, by = 5) 
age_labels = paste0(age_breaks[-length(age_breaks)], "-", age_breaks[-1] - 1)

# Filter data to exclude age 80 and above
poly_df_eda = poly_df %>% 
  filter(part_age < 80, cnt_age < 80)
```

```{r}
# Load plotting functions
source(here('scripts', 'src', 'assessment_plot_func.R'))

data_m1_hm  = readRDS(here('data', 'processed', 'm1_plot_data_heatmap.rds'))
fixed_max = 10

# Create the main heatmap Grob
grob_poly_hm = create_heatmap_grob_simple(data_m1_hm, "Contact Matrix", is_polymod_panel = TRUE, max_val = fixed_max)

# Create the color bar Grob
grob_legend_hm = create_heatmap_legend_grob(max_val = fixed_max)

plot_loc_hm = here(plot_path, 'polymod_contact_matrix_legend.pdf')

# Widen the plot from 8cm to 10.5cm to accommodate the color bar
pdf(plot_loc_hm, width = 10.5 * cm, height = 8 * cm, pointsize = 10)
  grid.newpage()
  
  # 1x2 layout. The 2nd column is for the color bar with a fixed width of 2.0cm
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(nrow = 1, ncol = 2, widths = unit(c(1, 2.0), c("null", "cm")))))
    
    # Left: Heatmap
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1))
      grid.draw(grob_poly_hm)
    popViewport()
    
    # Right: Color bar
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 2))
      grid.draw(grob_legend_hm)
    popViewport()
    
  popViewport()
dev.off()
```

## Age Distribution

```{r}
part_data = poly_df_eda %>% distinct(part_id, part_age)
age_counts = table(factor(floor(part_data$part_age / 5) * 5, levels = seq(0, 75, by = 5)))
df_age_dist = data.frame(age = as.numeric(names(age_counts)), count = as.numeric(age_counts))

create_age_dist_grob_v2 = function(df) {
  x_scale = c(0, 80)
  y_scale = c(0, max(df$count) * 1.1)
  
  main_vp = plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
  data_vp = dataViewport(xData = x_scale, yData = y_scale, extension = 0)
  
  bars = rectGrob(
    x = unit(df$age + 2.5, "native"),
    y = unit(0, "native"),
    width = unit(5, "native"), 
    height = unit(df$count, "native"),
    just = "bottom",
    gp = gpar(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6, col = "black")
  )
  
  major_at = seq(0, 80, by = 10)
  minor_at = seq(5, 75, by = 10)
  
  ticks_major = segmentsGrob(
    x0 = unit(major_at, "native"), y0 = unit(0, "npc"),
    x1 = unit(major_at, "native"), y1 = unit(-2.0, "mm"), gp = gpar(col = "black")
  )
  ticks_minor = segmentsGrob(
    x0 = unit(minor_at, "native"), y0 = unit(0, "npc"),
    x1 = unit(minor_at, "native"), y1 = unit(-1.0, "mm"), gp = gpar(col = "black")
  )
  labels_x = textGrob(
    label = as.character(major_at),
    x = unit(major_at, "native"), y = unit(-3.5, "mm"),
    just = "top", gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )
  
  ax_y = yaxisGrob(gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
  
  xlab = textGrob("Age", y = unit(-2.5, "lines"))
  ylab = textGrob("Count", x = unit(-3, "lines"), rot = 90)
  
  gTree(children = gList(
    rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = "white")),
    ticks_major, ticks_minor, labels_x, ax_y, 
    linesGrob(x = unit(c(0, 1), "npc"), y = unit(c(0, 0), "npc")),
    bars, xlab, ylab
  ), vp = vpStack(main_vp, data_vp))
}

pdf(here(plot_path, 'polymod_age_distribution.pdf'), width = 8 * cm, height = 8 * cm, pointsize = 10)
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(create_age_dist_grob_v2(df_age_dist))
dev.off()
```

## Age Difference by Location

```{r}
locs = c("Home", "School", "Work", "Leisure")
age_diff_list = lapply(locs, function(l) {
  vals = abs(poly_df_eda$part_age[poly_df_eda$location_category == l] - poly_df_eda$cnt_age[poly_df_eda$location_category == l])
  density(vals[!is.na(vals)], from = 0, to = 60)
})

pdf(here(plot_path, 'polymod_agediff_location.pdf'), width = 16 * cm, height = 16 * cm, pointsize = 10)
  grid.newpage()
  main_layout = grid.layout(2, 2)
  pushViewport(viewport(layout = main_layout))
  
  for (i in 1:4) {
    row_idx = (i - 1) %/% 2 + 1
    col_idx = (i - 1) %% 2 + 1
    
    pushViewport(viewport(layout.pos.row = row_idx, layout.pos.col = col_idx))
    pushViewport(plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1)))
    
    d = age_diff_list[[i]]
    title_str = locs[i]
    
    y_max = ifelse(title_str == "School", 0.4, 0.1)
    y_ticks = if (title_str == "School") c(0, 0.2, 0.4) else c(0, 0.05, 0.1)
    
    data_vp = dataViewport(xData = c(0, 60), yData = c(0, y_max), extension = 0)
    pushViewport(data_vp)
    
      grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = "black"))
      
      poly_x = c(d$x[1], d$x, d$x[length(d$x)])
      poly_y = c(0, d$y, 0)
      grid.polygon(poly_x, poly_y, default.units = "native", gp = gpar(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3, col = NA))
      
      grid.lines(d$x, d$y, default.units = "native", gp = gpar(col = "steelblue", lwd = 2))
      
      grid.xaxis(at = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60), gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
      grid.yaxis(at = y_ticks, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
      
      grid.text("Age Difference", y = unit(-2.5, "lines"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
      grid.text("Density", x = unit(-3.5, "lines"), rot = 90,
                gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
      grid.text(title_str, x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(1, "npc") - unit(1, 'lines'))
      
    popViewport(3)
  }
  
  popViewport()
dev.off()
```

## Gender Ratio

```{r}
gender_counts = table(poly_df %>% distinct(part_id, part_gender) %>% pull(part_gender))
df_gender = data.frame(gender = names(gender_counts), count = as.numeric(gender_counts))
df_gender$pct = df_gender$count / sum(df_gender$count) * 100

df_gender$label = ifelse(df_gender$gender == "F", "Female", "Male")

create_gender_grob = function(df) {
  y_max = max(df$count) * 1.2
  main_vp = plotViewport(margins = c(4, 4, 1, 1))
  data_vp = dataViewport(xData = c(0.5, 2.5), yData = c(0, y_max), extension = 0)
  
  bars = rectGrob(
    x = unit(1:2, "native"),
    y = unit(0, "native"),
    width = unit(0.6, "native"),
    height = unit(df$count, "native"),
    just = "bottom",
    gp = gpar(fill = c("salmon", "skyblue"), col = "black")
  )
  
  pct_labels = textGrob(
    paste0(round(df$pct, 1), "%"),
    x = unit(1:2, "native"),
    y = unit(df$count, "native") + unit(0.5, "lines"),
    just = "bottom",
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )
  
  ax_x = xaxisGrob(at = 1:2, label = df$label)
  ax_y = yaxisGrob()
  
  gTree(children = gList(
    rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = "white")),
    bars, pct_labels, ax_x, ax_y
  ), vp = vpStack(main_vp, data_vp))
}

pdf(here(plot_path, 'polymod_gender_ratio.pdf'), width = 8 * cm, height = 8 * cm, pointsize = 10)
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(create_gender_grob(df_gender))
dev.off()
```
